title: George Filhe, a good trombone player
summary: Robinson says George Field played brass band and jazz and was a good trombonist.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: They were on my guitar there. All the hands, but then they were on the guitar. All hands. All hands. Oh, you mentioned George Field, who did he play with?
Well, I don't remember who George played, but I know that George was one of them good
style bands, because of the other band. Was it? He was a good trombone player.
Was it a dance band or a brass band he was doing?

He was playing brass band, and jazz band too. I think George was playing with only Robichaud I think. No, but I know what Vic Gasco, but Robichaud Trombone player. But I know George Field is one of them good bands.
